purpose: Held-out synthetic post-development RAG quality evaluation. Keep these questions separate from threshold calibration examples.

pages: Harbor Operations Alert Procedures. During an amber tide alert, staff check the tide gauges every 30 minutes. During a red tide alert, staff check the gauges every 10 minutes. Send every tide alert report to the harbor desk.
Harbor Evacuation Drill. The assembly point is the west lot. Staff sign in with the drill marshal. Check the backup generator fuel every Friday.
North Greenhouse Growing Notes. The target soil pH is 6.2. The tomato cultivar is Solara. Water each tomato plant with 1.5 liters on Monday and Thursday. Solara tomatoes usually ripen in 78 days.
Sample Handling Notes. Store harvested basil at 4 degrees Celsius. Put the harvest date on each sample label. The greenhouse lab manager is Mira Chen.
Cold Room Procedures. Keep the cold room between 2 and 5 degrees Celsius. Record the temperature logger at 08:00 and 16:00 each day. Report any temperature deviation within 15 minutes.
Dispatch Schedule. The morning dispatch leaves from dock 3 at 06:30. Return reusable crates to bay B. The Pine route carries 3 cases of water.
Eyewash Station Inspection. Flush each eyewash station for 15 minutes every month. Verify the inspection seal after flushing. Record the inspection in the safety binder.
Emergency Contacts. Call the safety desk for workplace emergencies. The safety desk extension is 204. Replace any damaged emergency labels.
Map Collection Index. Box A17 contains regional maps dated 1984. Photo negatives are stored on shelf 6. Use a green request form to access archive materials.
Archive Room Conditions. Maintain room humidity between 40 and 50 percent. Return checked-out materials within 3 days. The archivist is Jo Park.
Solar Array Maintenance Log. The south roof array produced 240 kilowatt-hours on a clear day in April. The inverter model is Helio-4. Clean the panels on the first Tuesday of each month.
Battery Reserve Notes. The minimum battery reserve is 18 percent. The weekly maintenance window starts at 21:00 on Tuesday. Record battery readings in the blue operations log.
